versions.changelog:
- Launch of "Typhoon Chichijima Ogasawara — Riding Out a Typhoon | AI Experience": immerse yourself in 20-step journey through a remote island typhoon.
- Medium-intensity adventure spans 1–2 weeks, highlighting the solitude and awe of sheltering on Chichijima as a powerful storm passes.
- Journey features start, registration, and step-advance endpoints, with optional personal reflections at each stage.
- Personalizes narratives using info like your timezone and location when provided.
- Post-experience, receive a postcard compiling your journey reflections.
- Skill is user-invocable and suitable for anyone interested in nature, resilience, and remote adventure.
